subject: Gartner research call: Acme Health reference + usage details
messages:
From: Priya Shah <pshah@gartner.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Gartner research call - Acme Health reference request

Hi Olga,

I hope you’re well. I’m an analyst covering inference platforms and I’m preparing a short vendor note focused on inference economics for healthcare customers. Acme Health has been suggested as a good customer reference for Redwood.

Would someone from your team be available for a 30-minute call next week (Oct 20-22) to: 
- Confirm high-level architecture and deployment mode (private vs dedicated)
- Discuss token cost trends and any quantization/latency trade-offs you helped them with
- Share a short usage snapshot (Q2/Q3 2026) and outcomes

If okay, I’d like to speak with a technical contact at Acme (ops/infra) plus a product/owner who can speak to outcomes. We can anonymize any sensitive metrics.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Principal Analyst, Gartner
Attachments: none
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <pshah@gartner.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gartner research call - Acme Health reference request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for reaching out. Happy to help. I can coordinate the customer side and set up a brief reference call with Acme. Tom Benson (Head of ML Ops at Acme) and Elena Ruiz (Program Owner) are the most appropriate. I'll loop them in and confirm times.

Two quick notes from our side:
- We typically ask customers to sign a short reference consent (one page) for analyst calls; I'll include our reference guidelines.
- We can share an aggregated usage snapshot (Q3 2026) and a small redacted CSV for your review.

Proposed timeslots: Tue Oct 20 11:00-11:30 PT or Wed Oct 21 09:00-09:30 PT. Which works for you?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-reference-guidelines.pdf
From: Tom Benson <tbenson@acmehealth.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <pshah@gartner.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <eruiz@acmehealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gartner research call - Acme Health reference request

Thanks Olga, Priya.

We're available for Wed Oct 21 09:00 PT. Quick context from our side:
- We run Redwood Private in a VPC for PHI-adjacent workloads and Redwood Dedicated for non-sensitive inference.
- Our ML Ops team (me) can cover deployment and perf trade-offs; Elena can cover business outcomes and cost savings.

I can share a short usage snapshot CSV (Q3) after internal signoff. I don't think we need anything more formal than the one-page consent.

Tom
Head of ML Ops, Acme Health
Attachment: acme_health_usage_summary_q32026.csv (pending signoff)
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Benson <tbenson@acmehealth.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@gartner.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-10-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gartner research call - Acme Health reference request

Great — Wed Oct 21 09:00 PT is confirmed. Call details below: 
- Dial-in: Zoom (link) — I'll send the calendar invite
- Agenda (30 min): 1) brief intro (5m) 2) architecture & infra (10m) 3) outcomes/cost impacts (10m) 4) any clarifying Qs (5m)

Marissa (Customer Advocacy) will run the intro; Vivek can join for any question about batching/quantization recommendations. Aditya, can you prepare a 2-slide summary on the perf/cost changes we implemented for Acme (latency improvements, token cost delta)?

Also: Tom, attaching our one-page consent PDF for your legal team to review. If you prefer we can walk through it on the call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Advocacy, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-reference-guidelines.pdf
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Gartner research call - Acme Health reference request

Quick follow-up after confirming logistics: 

- Call invite sent for Wed Oct 21 09:00 PT (Zoom details in calendar).
- Tom has signoff to share the redacted CSV; we received the file and I've attached a sanitized version for Priya.
- Aditya: thanks for the 2-slide summary ahead of the call; please keep slides very light and include the quantization profile we used (INT8) and the latency improvement numbers.

Priya: if you'd like the customer to avoid any PHI in their comments, we can provide suggested phrasing for the call.

Looking forward — appreciate the analyst coverage.

Best,
Olga
